scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Pointwise Multiple Ergodic Averages for Mixing Transformations” (preprints/Pointwise-Multiple-Ergodic-Averages-for-Mixing-Transformations-October-4-2026/multiple-ergodic-averages.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 154 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b9d8fcffac455475), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose that T satisfies (1.1). For every integer n ≥ 2 and every fixed f1, . . . , fn ∈ L∞(µ), AN (f1, . . . , fn)(x) −→ n ∏︂ j=1 ∫︂ X fj dµ for µ-almost every x, as N tends to infinity through all positive integers. The probability space need not be standard, and no rate of mixing is required.
